id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master

fields.topology_type: Point-to-point Source -> single embedded panel Sink over the Main Link (1/2/4 lanes) plus a bidirectional AUX channel and HPD sideband, on a short internal flex. There is NO external connector and NO MST tree.

supported_topologies.name: Embedded single-panel link
supported_topologies.description: One Source -> one internal panel Sink over 1/2/4 Main Link lanes.

supported_topologies.name: Panel Self Refresh
supported_topologies.description: Source quiesces the Main Link; the panel refreshes from its Remote Frame Buffer (RFB).

master_slave_role_summary.description: On-board display controller: drives the Main Link, masters the AUX channel, reads DPCD/EDID, trains the link, streams video, controls backlight + PSR.
Receives the Main Link, replies on AUX, exposes DPCD + eDP block + EDID, reports training + PSR status, drives HPD, holds the RFB.
Bidirectional half-duplex management channel shared by the link.

fields.interconnect_role: eDP is a Source-to-internal-panel display transport. The Main Link carries isochronous video uni-directionally; the AUX channel carries all management (DPCD + eDP block, training, EDID, backlight, PSR) bidirectionally. There is a single Sink (the embedded panel) — no branch devices or MST routing.

ordering_guarantees.stream_order: Per-frame video is isochronous and in-order; Transfer-Unit / MSA framing preserves the raster.
ordering_guarantees.psr: During PSR the panel refreshes from the RFB; on exit the Source re-transmits (full frame or PSR2 selective-update region).
ordering_guarantees.aux_order: AUX is strictly half-duplex request/reply, one transaction at a time.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: eDP's addressable space is the DPCD register map (20-bit AUX address), including the eDP-specific block at 00700h, plus the I2C address space reached by I2C-over-AUX (panel EDID at A0h). The Main Link video stream is addressless isochronous data; the panel-local RFB is internal to the Sink.

device_classification.source: GPU/SoC eDP transmitter: masters AUX, trains the Main Link, streams video, controls backlight + PSR.
device_classification.sink: Embedded panel TCON (eDP Sink): exposes DPCD + eDP block + EDID, reports status + PSR_STATUS, drives HPD, holds RFB.
device_classification.branch_device: MST hub/daisy-chain router using Sideband MSG and the 64-slot table.
device_classification.edp_panel: Embedded DisplayPort internal panel with Panel Replay.

default_signal_values_evidence_tables: VESA Embedded DisplayPort Standard — Main Link rates (RBR/HBR/HBR2/HBR3) and lane counts (1/2/4)
DPCD register-map structure (Receiver Capability / Link Configuration / Link Status + eDP-specific block at 00700h)
Link-training procedure (Fast Link Training + Clock Recovery + Channel Equalization, swing/pre-emphasis)
eDP-exclusive features (PSR / PSR2 + RFB, backlight-over-AUX, ASSR)
AUX transaction format (4-bit command, 20-bit address, ACK/NACK/DEFER) and I2C-over-AUX EDID
